# Telemetry export pipeline

Five components: a `poller` pulls raw samples from a device on a timer and feeds a `normalizer`, which also receives status from an independent `healthprobe`. Normalized samples land in a `buffer` (ring buffer) that an `exporter` drains toward a remote collector.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Telemetry export pipeline"

block poller "Poller"
block healthprobe "Health probe"
block normalizer "Normalizer"
block buffer "Ring buffer"
block exporter "Exporter"

poller -> normalizer
healthprobe -> normalizer
normalizer -> buffer
buffer -> exporter
```

<sub>source: [figures/telemetry-export-pipeline.fd](figures/telemetry-export-pipeline.fd)</sub>

Notes for the host doc:
- The five block ids match those given: `poller`, `normalizer`, `healthprobe`, `buffer`, `exporter`.
- Only the four connections implied by the description are drawn; no timer or remote-collector detail is folded into labels — that stays in surrounding prose per the "don't cram the story into the figure" guidance.
- This should be built with `node build-svg.js telemetry-export-pipeline.fd` before embedding, to get the actual deterministic SVG.
